findings.contract: The origin fixture owns connection and response tasks and observes their failures.
findings.cause: The listener spawns unretained connection tasks, which spawn unretained response tasks. Drop aborts only the listener. H3 construction/accept/resolve failures return silently; response task Result is unobserved. The /stall response remains pending.
findings.verification_needed: Drive actual /stall traffic, retain client/runtime beyond origin drop, and observe connection/response destruction at the real child ownership boundaries. Exercise an actual child error and ordinary positive exchange; preserve expected trust-root rejection semantics.

findings.contract: SOCKS test peers remain owned during setup, early errors, cancellation and multi-peer result collection.
findings.cause: Raw origin and proxy JoinHandles surround fallible setup/client work and sequential joins. Early errors or assertions discard handles; a first joined error can skip the sibling result.
findings.verification_needed: Drive real remote-DNS SOCKS CONNECT plus request bytes; retain client beyond the cancelled/failed path and observe peer destruction. Preserve two completed distinct failure objects and existing literal host, port, request, frame and stream-ID oracles.

findings.contract: A test deadline retains the actual timer error.
findings.cause: The bounded wrappers and two CONNECT-UDP operation deadlines replace Elapsed with fixed strings.
findings.verification_needed: Poll each existing timer path before advancing/expiring it; check actual typed Elapsed and typed inner-error/success positives. Preserve 30-second, 10-second and 5-second limits.

findings.contract: The terminal retry trace assertion observes at least one actual outcome.
findings.cause: all(|retries| *retries == 0) also accepts an empty observation vector.
findings.verification_needed: Exercise actual terminal request trace plus a deliberately absent observer using the same assertion; reject missing observations and retain literal zero retries.

standards_cleanup: Group standard, external and local imports before module declarations.
Describe capsule length/context assertions literally; they do not independently decode or identify a full QUIC Initial.
observable_contracts_read: Literal remote DNS IDNA host and SOCKS target port, plaintext request bytes, HTTP/2 stream IDs, WebSocket accept/frame and EOF.
CONNECT-UDP three explicit outer legs, literal H1 Upgrade head and H2/H3 semantic fields, credential sensitivity, independent roots/client certificate, rejection categories, reuse and outer closure.
Finite no-I/O listener/endpoint observations fail on inner accept errors or endpoint closure.
Capture assertions check selected span/event values and secret canaries, not all possible diagnostics.
limits: Fresh full read is distinct from prior partial reports; no source edits or test execution in this pass.
No measured host task leak, permanent OS resource leak, production-client defect or new browser acceptance claim.
Shared MASQUE implementation and other test peers are not freshly fully reviewed in this pass.
Origin/client counts and absent requests do not alone observe every byte of an attempted handshake.
New findings require causal execution, remedies and independent review; no whole-architecture completion.
